origin: New program written on November 13, 2026 by Carl Kadie with Claude (Anthropic), in TRS-80 Level II BASIC, at the user's request. It is not a recovered cassette or disk and makes no historical claim.

sources_ported.name: Linkage Blaze Armatron demo
sources_ported.used: Arm turtle chain, joint ranges, camera rig, target placement from a hidden target pose, fingertip distance, greedy coordinate-search auto-reach, perspective projection.

sources_ported.name: Excel 2D & 3D Robot Arms
sources_ported.used: Same Armatron chain as rows of yaw/pitch/roll/move; the SIN-based pseudo-random target hash, adapted to Level II single precision.

differences_from_sources: One-pixel lines at 128x48; no joint spheres or pen widths.
The 9x9 floor line grid becomes a 5x5 grid of dots.
As in Linkage Blaze, a hidden target pose run through the same arm routine places a reachable target. The target is a cross with a dotted line to the floor.
Target poses come from a SIN hash of the target number, not WyRand.
Auto-reach searches only the four joints that move the fingertip, takes the first improving move, and applies up to four moves per redraw instead of interpolating.
Keyboard keys replace sliders and buttons.
